description.en: Planned fossil-form study featuring laterally compressed curved cap shell with a projecting subapical snorkel tube.
description.zh: 拟议形态研究：侧扁弯帽壳在壳顶下方伸出管状口。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning study grounded in a named taxon source; reconstructed or simplified components remain artistic interpretations.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据具名分类单元来源进行属级规划；补全及简化结构仍属于复原或美术解释。

distinctness.en: A distinct construction based on laterally compressed curved cap shell with a projecting subapical snorkel tube; not a size, color or posture variant.
distinctness.zh: 以侧扁弯帽壳在壳顶下方伸出管状口建立独立几何结构，而非尺寸、配色或姿势变体。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish laterally compressed curved cap shell with a projecting subapical snorkel tube; emphasize the largest gaps and changes in contour. Simplify fine repeated surfaces; do not copy source geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先搭建侧扁弯帽壳在壳顶下方伸出管状口，突出主要间隙和轮廓变化，简化细小重复表面，不复制来源网格。

uncertainty: Named source supports the principal form. Species-level dimensions, missing structures and soft tissues still require a selected specimen reference.
reference_notes: Named concept revised during taxonomic and silhouette review. No exact coexistence is implied.

sources.title: Revisiting the molluscan fauna from the Cambrian Xinji Formation of North China
sources.supports: Yochelcionella tall laterally compressed curved shell with projecting subapical tubular snorkel; Cambrian context.
